_why.day.TRAIL_MINUTES: 18 min draws Finch, Sheppard and Eglinton as continuous lines instead of dotted rows; whiteout stays 0.012
_why.TRAIL_CORE_W: 4 px cores keep the Toronto street grid as pink lines after the VP9 round trip; downtown stays separated, whiteout 0.013
_why.TRAIL_LAYER_ALPHA: 0.8 makes the pink grid read under the white dots in the RT crop and cuts strobe 0.020 to 0.017; gaps stay dark
_why.TIME_WARP_GAMMA: 1.5 slows the pm rush (3:42 to 5:25 per eighth) and cuts midnight to 5 am to 3.3 s without a faster peak rate
_why.CARD_LINES: line 2 is two short lines that read at a glance; the trains video after it opens on line 1
_why.OUTSIDE_DIM: 0.75 drops Mississauga and York Region to a faint hint, so Toronto reads 4.2x brighter than its neighbours (b: 2.9x)
_why.week.BUS_HALO_ALPHA: 0.15 lets soft glows travel along the dotless week grid: RT motion 0.31 to 0.40, strobe stays 0.0003
